html: Pick two milestones from this lesson, one before 1970 and one after 2000, and write one sentence on what the later one could do that the earlier one could not.

For each job, choose a robot structure and say why, using the spec sheets above: screwing small parts into a circuit board, welding a car frame, picking cookies off a fast conveyor, lifting an engine block.
Calculate how long a command takes to reach Mars at the shortest and longest delays given here, and how far a rover moving at 4 cm/s would travel in that time.
The three frames you set up when programming an arm: the base frame at the robot’s foot, the tool frame at the TCP, and the work object on the fixture. Targets are measured from the work object.[17]
Before you order parts, write your M0 pin map. Assign the two encoder channels, the PWM output, the two direction outputs and three buttons on an Uno, and explain why the PWM is not on pin 3.

The wiring the two programs below assume. The sensor on the control box says a part is waiting; the tool outputs command the gripper, and the tool input proves the grip before the robot moves away. Change the numbers to match your own gripper.

Optional: paste the URScript from section 07 into a Script node or file, and compare the motion with your tree program. If you have RobotStudio (within the trial, or under a school Education license), repeat the exercise with the RAPID module from section 08 and redefine wobjFixture with the three-point method.

Categorize each of the following tasks as best suited for a Topic, a Service, or an Action: (a) streaming 30 fps video from a depth camera; (b) navigating a mobile robot across a room to docking station 4; (c) setting a digital gripper output to release a part. Justify your choices.
Explain in your own words why an engineer testing an autonomous driving algorithm prefers testing against a recorded ros2 bag file before testing on real hardware on public roads.

The Lyrical Windows install uses pixi and conda-forge. In every Command Prompt you run pixi shell and then call C:\dev\lyrical\local_setup.bat; C++ builds need Visual Studio Build Tools 2022, run from the "x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022".[6] On Windows you build with colcon build --merge-install and source with call install\setup.bat (or install\setup.ps1 in PowerShell).[3][5] The Lyrical workspace and colcon tutorials still mention the VS 2019 prompt and C:\dev\ros2; follow the install page where they disagree.[3][6]

The setup.py listing in the Lyrical "Creating a package" tutorial uses package_name = 'my_py_pkg' and the entry point 'my_node = my_py_pkg.my_node:main', while the rest of that page uses my_package.[7] If you copy it word for word, the names will not match your package. Always check that the names in setup.py match your folder names.

What the turtlesim_mimic launch file starts. The two simulators share the node name sim but live in different namespaces, and the remappings connect mimic's generic topics to the first turtle's pose and the second turtle's velocity command.

Wire a dual H-bridge driver (such as a TB6612FNG or L298N) to a separate battery and motor, ensuring the battery Ground and Arduino Ground pins are securely bridged. Test bidirectional motor rotation by toggling the direction pins.
Calculate the linear distance traveled by a mobile robot with 80 mm diameter wheels equipped with 360 PPR encoders running 4x decoding, if the microcontroller registers 4,520 encoder ticks.
For D = 0.5 m and a quintic time scaling, find the smallest T that keeps the peak velocity under 0.25 m/s and the peak acceleration under 0.5 m/s². Compare it with the trapezoid's 2.5 s.

Choose a method from this lesson for each image, and give your reason. The cases are: dark parts on a bright, evenly lit conveyor; the same parts with a shadow across half the image; and red caps and blue caps that are equally bright.
Three-wire sensor wiring: NPN sensors switch the signal line to supply common (-), requiring a sourcing input; PNP sensors switch the signal line to supply source (+), requiring a sinking input.[2]

You have two proximity sensors, one NPN and one PNP. For each, say whether its output switches the signal line to supply common or to positive supply, and whether it needs a sinking or a sourcing PLC input.
Universal Robots’ example of galvanic isolation: the robot output only drives the relay, and the relay’s contact switches a signal from an external supply to the frequency converter.[5]
